description: This Java class defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application, providing centralized handling for various exceptions and returning standardized error responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller advice class handling global exceptions and returning consistent error responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler.ErrorResponse
classes.description: A static inner class representing a structured error response with timestamp, status, error message, and additional details.

methods.name: handleRuntimeException
methods.description: Handles RuntimeException and returns a BAD REQUEST response with details.

methods.name: handleUsernameNotFoundException
methods.description: Handles UsernameNotFoundException and returns a NOT FOUND response.

methods.name: handleBadCredentialsException
methods.description: Handles BadCredentialsException and returns an UNAUTHORIZED response.

methods.name: handleAccessDeniedException
methods.description: Handles AccessDeniedException and returns a FORBIDDEN response.

methods.name: handleValidationExceptions
methods.description: Handles validation errors from invalid method arguments and returns detailed errors.

methods.name: handleGenericException
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions and returns an INTERNAL SERVER ERROR response.
